lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Code blue, adult arrest in room three. Start the clock.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Jordan, start high-quality compressions now.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Taylor, place pads and connect the defibrillator.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Airway at head of bed, prepare bag-valve-mask with oxygen.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Pause compressions for rhythm check.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Ventricular fibrillation. Charge to 200 joules biphasic.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Everybody clear. Deliver shock.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Resume compressions immediately.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Ventilate every six seconds, avoid hyperventilation.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Get IV or IO access now.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Prepare epinephrine one milligram IV push.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Give epinephrine now and flush.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Switch compressors at the next pulse check.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Pause for rhythm and pulse check.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Still VF. Charge to 300 joules.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Clear. Shock on my count, three two one shock.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Back on the chest, resume compressions.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Prepare amiodarone 300 milligrams IV push.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Administer amiodarone now.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Two-minute cycle nearly complete, get ready to check rhythm.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Pause compressions. Check rhythm and pulse.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Organized rhythm on monitor. Do you feel a pulse?

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: We have ROSC. Start post-arrest care, target oxygen saturation ninety-four to ninety-eight.

lapel_mic_transcript.speaker: Team Leader
lapel_mic_transcript.text: Obtain blood pressure, twelve-lead ECG, and prepare transfer to ICU.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Nurse B
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: IV line secured in left antecubital.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Nurse B
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: Epinephrine one milligram IV given, flushing now.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Recorder
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: Epinephrine given at one-thirty on code clock.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Compressor 2
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: Ready to switch in at next pause.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Respiratory Therapist
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: Airway maintained, end-tidal CO2 is rising.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Compressor 2
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: Pausing compressions for rhythm and pulse.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Monitor Nurse
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: Organized narrow complex rhythm on monitor.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Nurse B
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: I feel a carotid pulse, weak but present.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Recorder
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: ROSC achieved at three minutes thirty seconds.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Nurse A
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: Blood pressure eighty-six over fifty, starting fluid bolus.

ceiling_mic_transcript.speaker: Transport Team
ceiling_mic_transcript.text: ICU bed confirmed, moving patient now.

video_events.details: Code blue strobe and audible alarm activate; bedside team turns toward patient.
First responders and crash cart enter room.
Compressor begins chest compressions at center of sternum.
Anterior-lateral pads placed and monitor leads connected.
Respiratory therapist delivers bag-valve-mask breaths with oxygen.
Hands lifted from chest for rhythm analysis.
Monitor displays coarse ventricular fibrillation.
Defibrillator discharge delivered at 200 J; patient torso jolts.
Compressions restart within seconds after first shock.
Peripheral IV catheter secured in left arm.
Medication syringe pushed through IV port followed by saline flush.
Second compressor rotates in with minimal interruption.
Second rhythm check pause.
VF remains on monitor after second cycle.
Second shock delivered at 300 J.
Compressions restart immediately after second shock.
300 mg amiodarone visibly pushed IV.
Capnography trend rises on monitor, suggesting improved perfusion.
Team pauses to assess rhythm and pulse.
Monitor changes from VF to organized narrow-complex rhythm.
Bedside nurse palpates carotid pulse and nods to leader.
Team transitions from arrest algorithm to post-ROSC stabilization.
IV fluids initiated and 12-lead ECG electrodes applied.
Patient moved out on stretcher toward ICU with transport team.
